thread:
Priya (AE): Hey legal — Sierra Labs is ready to sign the order form but they're flagging a KMS/HSM addendum + net45 PO requirement. Attached draft OF below, can legal advise on redlines and signer lane? Prefer DocuSign flow.

Marco (Sales Eng): Quick context — POC will use Dedicated (4x A100 reserved). Pricing line below for legal/finance reference. If they insist on HSM, we may need Private deployment notes. Snippet: ```Order Form: Product: Redwood Dedicated
Qty: 4 GPUs
Term: 12 mo
Price: $24,000/mo
KMS: Customer-managed (BYOK) or equivalent HSM attestation```

Tessa (Legal): On it. Please paste the customer's proposed clause. Also need to know whether they require HSM only or would accept KMS with attestation. @Renee FYI on net45.

Priya (AE): Customer pasted their clause in the email thread — they require HSM + explicit subprocessor prohibitions, and they will only issue a PO after the DPA/MSA are fully executed. Countersigner email: corp-signer@sierra.com

Renee (Finance): Net45 is workable but we need a PO number and billing entity before provisioning. Send PO to billing@redwood.com. We'll run quick credit and pre-approve up to $200k for this deal.

Tessa (Legal): Reviewed the HSM wording — too prescriptive. Proposed redline (high level): allow Customer-managed KMS or HSM equivalence with an attestation and limitations on subprocessors. I'll propose language: ```Customer may use Customer-managed key management (KMS) or HSM; Redwood will provide attestation of key management controls and limit subprocessor access to the narrow set required for provisioning and monitoring.```

Priya (AE): Shared our redlines with the customer. They replied that they need the DPA signed before issuing a PO and requested DocuSign execution with countersign by both legal and procurement.

Sam (Solutions): Suggested routing to keep timeline: AE uploads OF -> Legal approves redlines -> Finance acknowledges net45 -> docusign-bot creates envelope -> Legal signs -> Customer countersigns -> Sales marks PO received -> Ops schedules provisioning. We should also mark an expedited lane for this POC.

Tessa (Legal): Agreed. I'll add a short fallback SLA paragraph for Dedicated (latency SLO + credits) and clean up the KMS/HSM language.

Priya (AE): Customer says they want POC started in 2 weeks. If we can sign today, they will send PO by EOD tomorrow. Can legal/finance expedite?

Marco (Sales Eng): Ops note — we can provision once we have signed OF + PO. To accelerate, we can spin up dev trial access for their engineers immediately and hold Dedicated provisioning until PO is cleared.

docusign-bot: Envelope 0xC4 created and sent to corp-signer@sierra.com (status: sent). Link: https://docusign.net/envelope/0xC4

Priya (AE): @Tessa @Renee please ack when you sign so I can update the customer. Final OF snippet: ```OrderForm: Redwood Dedicated - 4xA100 reserved
Term: 12 months
MonthlyCharge: $24,000
SetupFee: $5,000
Billing: Net45 to Redwood Inc., PO required (send to billing@redwood.com)```

Tessa (Legal): Signed. Uploaded executed DPA/MSA at 2026-03-22 17:45 PST. If customer comes back with HSM-only language, ping me immediately.

Renee (Finance): Invoice team notified, awaiting PO# to create invoice. CC'd billing@redwood.com on the thread.

Priya (AE): Customer sent PO# SL-54321 and uploaded signed DocuSign envelope. Moving to ops for provisioning. Thanks everyone :party_parrot:
